''Τίτορμος'' (Titormus) | image = Panetolikos_F.C._logo.svg | image_size = 180px | upright = 0.94 | fullname = Pan-Aetolian Gymnastic and Educational Football Club | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1926|3|9}} | ground = [[Panetolikos Stadium]] | capacity = 7,321 | owntitle = Owner | owner = Fotis Kostoulas | chrtitle = President | chairman = Gerasimos Belevonis | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Giannis Anastasiou]] | league = [[Super League Greece]] | season = [[2025–26 Super League Greece|2025–26]] | position = [[Super League Greece]], 12th of 14 | website = {{URL|https://panetolikos.gr/|panetolikos.gr}} | current = 2025–26 Panetolikos F.C. season | pattern_la1 = _panetolikos2526h | pattern_b1 = _panetolikos2526h | pattern_ra1 = _panetolikos2526h | pattern_sh1 = _panetolikos2526h | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = ffea00 | body1 = ffea00 | rightarm1 = ffea00 | shorts1 = ffea00 | socks1 = ffea00 | pattern_la2 = _panetolikos2526a | pattern_b2 = _panetolikos2526a | pattern_ra2 = _panetolikos2526a | pattern_sh2 = _panetolikos2526a | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 0000ff | body2 = 0000ff | rightarm2 = 0000ff | shorts2 = 0000ff | socks2 = 0000ff | pattern_la3 = _panetolikos2526t | pattern_b3 = _panetolikos2526t | pattern_ra3 = _panetolikos2526t | pattern_sh3 = _panetolikos2526t | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = 005233 | body3 = 005233 | rightarm3 = 005233 | shorts3 = 005233 | socks3 = 005233 }} '''Panetolikos Football Club''' ({{langx|el|ΠΑΕ Παναιτωλικός}}), or with its full name officially romanized as '''Panaitolikós Gymnastikós Filekpaideftikós Sýllogos''' ({{langx|el|Παναιτωλικός Γυμναστικός Φιλεκπαιδευτικός Σύλλογος}}''; Pan-[[Aetolia]]n Gymnastic and Educational Club''), is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club. It is based in [[Agrinio]], Greece. Panetolikos was founded in 1926 and is considered one of the historical clubs in Greece, currently participating in the [[Super League Greece|Greek First Division]]. Some of the most well known players that started their career in the club are [[Stratos Apostolakis]], former Greek recordman in international [[Cap (sport)|caps]] (96), and [[Petros Michos]]. Team colors are [[yellow]] and [[blue]]. The club's symbol is [[Titormus]], the ancient Aetolian hero and their motto is "''Τίτορμος Αιτωλός Ούτος Άλλος Ηρακλής"'' (''Títormos'' ''Etolós Oútos Állos Iraklís),'' translated as ''[[Titormus]] the Aetolian is another Heracles''.{{cite web|url=http://www.panetolikosac.gr/gfs/%CE%B9%CF%83%CF%84%CE%BF%CF%81%CE%AF%CE%B1/item/28-titormos-aitolos-emblima|title=Titormus, the Aetolian, the emblem of Panetolikos|publisher=panetolikosac.gr|language=el|access-date=18 October 2018|archive-date=18 October 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181018161829/http://www.panetolikosac.gr/gfs/%CE%B9%CF%83%CF%84%CE%BF%CF%81%CE%AF%CE%B1/item/28-titormos-aitolos-emblima|url-status=live}}"}}
